mentions.name: Vibe-coded microcontroller firmware project
mentions.description: A clean-sheet microcontroller firmware project used as a low-risk experiment with AI coding assistants. The author observes that AI-generated hard-coded hexadecimal constants are consistently hallucinations, and considers feeding chip datasheets into the AI to see whether the constants improve.
mentions.source_excerpt: Vibe coding a microcontroller firmware project. I'm using "vibe coding" in jest here because I'm actually an experienced coder, but this was a chance to try using the AI coding assistants for a clean sheet project at minimal risk.
